capabilities.complete_execution: At most one model-selected changed candidate, complete simulation, unchanged reach evaluation and sampled holding/profile feedback.
capabilities.local_comparison: Optional one paired local comparison, two solves, <=300 charged seconds, at a saved baseline update with effective horizon 0.01 s; select one changed positive weight. Existing previous-input cold seed and integration retained. Unavailable/inconclusive screening does not prohibit a justified complete experiment.

instructions: Read at least one prediction view and one motion or plans view. At most two successful reading turns; independent views can be batched. Then submit a concise initial report with 2-4 facts selected using fact_handles, competing hypotheses, explicit gaps and recommendations. Use the current fact_catalog; the host resolves selectors, report.source and recommendation configuration_scope. Recommendations may defer pending a check. Do not execute or select a numerical check in this phase. Availability gaps must use inventory IDs and not_displayed, not_read, queried, not_retained or retained_unavailable; identify needed information/capability and basis. Unlisted evidence uses source plus explicit basis. Full sampled backend q/qdot is retained, even though motion shows the final window. Raw weight magnitudes do not establish cost-term importance without actual contributions/scaling. Diagnose the new common baseline. Only terminal_tip_speed_weight and holding_tip_speed_weight may later change under the explicit control grant. A reasonable testable hypothesis is enough to justify bounded exploration; proof of the dominant cause is not required. No geometry or material changes. Availability status applies to the entire inventory entry unless you supply update_ids (controller updates) or time_range_s (sampled backend motion). For a partially read entry, use queried and describe missing coverage, or explicitly scope a not_read/not_displayed declaration to the unread subset.

capability_gaps: No closed-loop counterfactual replay or causal attribution tool. Full trajectories are not in every request.
Existing numerical checks use a projected GVS state and bounded horizon, not a full backend replay.
inventory.claim_policy: Use inventory plus your receipt ledger: not_displayed, not_read in this context, queried with stated coverage, not_retained, or retained_unavailable through a named capability. A sampled view or failed raw gzip read does not prove absence.
